records.text: Nampa Christian's newsletter announced a Thursday morning assembly for high-school and middle-school students at the Flamingo campus with Erika Kirk, described as leading Turning Point Faith, on faith and leadership; chapel dress was recommended and the event was not being advertised or put on social media by NCS or TP Faith.
